name: Reito
description: A town a few miles from Eiganjo Castle, attacked by the kami.

description_citations.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The town of Reito is destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

citation.text: Ghostly Prison (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kami at Reito crush the militia and minor kami consume what remained.
timeline.quote: When the rampaging kami at Reito had crushed the opposing militia, swarms of minor kami swept over the battlefield to consume all that remained.

citation.text: Befoul (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Horobi, a new kami, rises from the ashes of Reito and comes at every battle.
timeline.quote: From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami.

citation.text: Horobi, Death's Wail (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Silverbeard told of a samurai lord he advised, who was ruined by a corrupt merchant's schemes.
timeline.quote: but a corrupt merchant brought about his ruin.

citation.text: "Silverbeard", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Silverbeard transformed the lord's offered helm into a tiny kami of light, secretly using his real powers.
timeline.quote: He transformed the helm into a tiny kami of light

citation.text: "Silverbeard", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The lord gave up his title and land, joined a monastery, and became a kami at death at 88.
timeline.quote: In the end, the samurai lord then discarded his title and land and joined a monastery to better serve the kami.

citation.text: "Silverbeard", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kami set upon the town of Reito, killing nearly every living thing, and the Kami War begins.
timeline.quote: A few miles from Eiganjo Castle, the kami set upon the town of Reito.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
